headline.text: L3 ML4 depositor guide rail broke and fell during production — *no record* of product hold or inspection for foreign material before restart.

summary: One active hold (L1 S2 mislabeled chocolate barrel). L3 ML4 restarted after equipment breakage without documented product check. Five sanitation ATP failures or floor-storage violations — all corrected within shift. L2 FFS feeder misconfigured, causing underweight pouches.

holds.title: Mislabeled chocolate barrel — dark in milk wrapper
holds.summary: One barrel of dark chocolate (item 10200) labeled as milk chocolate; IMS to relabel before release.
holds.status: On hold pending IMS relabel; no product released.

food_safety.title: ML4 depositor guide rail fell off during run — no FM check logged
food_safety.summary: Green plastic guide rail behind depositor 1 broke off mid-shift; maintenance repaired and line restarted, but no QA hold or inspection of product for foreign material fragments documented.
food_safety.status: Open — equipment repaired, line running; no record of product inspection or formal disposition of at-risk production.

quality.title: ML2 best-by date printing failures (missing, blurred)
quality.summary: Flow-wrap printer fault caused missing and blurred best-by dates on bars; affected product removed for rework, printer corrected, line resumed.
quality.status: Resolved — rework isolated, printer repaired, final cases inspected and cleared.

quality.title: FFS checkweigher excessive false rejects
quality.summary: Significant pitch errors on overweight side and QA blow-offs for foreign objects that clear when re-passed through X-ray; suggests calibration drift.
quality.status: Open — tracking counts, will involve maintenance if trend continues.

quality.title: FFS feeder target set to wrong weight
quality.summary: Feeder configured to 155 g instead of product target weight, causing low-weight pouches; Cy recalibrated checkweigher and corrected setting.
quality.status: Resolved — feeder target corrected, checkweigher recalibrated.

quality.title: ML4 laser coder for caddies failed intermittently all shift
quality.summary: Caddy lot-code printer faulted multiple times throughout first shift, causing accumulation; maintenance fixed trigger sensor by 16:11, operators re-inspected and re-printed affected pallets.
quality.status: Resolved — sensor repaired, one pallet spot-checked by QA, displays verified for lot and BB.

quality.title: Truffle flow-wrap sealing defects
quality.summary: Wrapper marks and tears easily during inspection at seal zone, compromising packaging integrity; operator advised to adjust.

quality.title: S2 FD labels not peeling, jars scrapped
quality.summary: FD labels on S2 jar line will not peel off adhesive backing, forcing jars to be scrapped; vendor contact requested.

quality.title: S2 metal detector sensitivity possibly too high
quality.summary: MD rejected 4 additional pieces after test cards passed; operator believes sensitivity setting may be elevated.

quality.title: ML4 scrap barrels not labeled
quality.summary: Scrap barrels at end of first shift had no labels; traceability gap for rework chocolate.

sanitation.title: Food-contact pots stored on floor
sanitation.summary: Multiple pots left on floor in violation of floor-storage prohibition; Wilson flagged to shift lead, pots washed, ATP passed.
sanitation.status: Resolved — pots washed, ATP swab passed at 19:28 MT.

sanitation.title: ML2 Hapman magnet and rubber hose failed ATP
sanitation.summary: Initial ATP swab failure on Hapman magnet and rubber hose at start of third shift; rewashed and retested — passed second ATP.
sanitation.status: Resolved — rewashed, passed ATP retest at 01:44 MT.

sanitation.title: ML1 C6 belt rollers dirty, belt control difficult
sanitation.summary: C6 belt tracked off repeatedly; maintenance noted rollers and components dirty, making tension adjustment difficult; belt replaced but root cause is inadequate shift cleaning.
sanitation.status: Open — new belt installed; maintenance suggested shift-by-shift roller cleaning to prevent recurrence.

sanitation.title: S4 kitchen area left dirty after L1 cleaning
sanitation.summary: QA observed dirty parts in kitchen area after level-1 cleaning despite flagging to crew; third shift corrected.
sanitation.status: Resolved — Victor Mejia confirmed areas cleaned properly at shift start.

sanitation.title: ML4 dirty molds sticking together in cooler 5
sanitation.summary: Molds entering cooler 5 heavily fouled, sticking together; Shawn asked if licking roller and preheating were on.
sanitation.status: Open — production checking licking roller and preheating settings.

opportunities.text: Review FFS checkweigher and X-ray rejection tuning — excessive pitch errors and false QA rejects suggest calibration drift or overly tight tolerances, based on Zack's third-shift tracking.
Consider adding equipment-breakage response to ML4 startup checklist — today's depositor guide rail failure restarted without documented product hold or FM inspection, based on the chat record.
Add C6 belt roller cleaning to ML1 shift checklist — today's repeated tracking failures trace to dirty rollers that maintenance could not adjust, per Jose's note after the third belt replacement.
